Package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.geo

package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.geo
Latency physics: SpeedOfLightLatency computes speed-of-light-in-fibre latency floors (one-way or round-trip) and haversine great-circle distances between IBXes, metros, or raw coordinates — fully offline once the endpoints' coordinates are known.

The figures are physical lower bounds (configurable fibre refractive index and route factor), used by the peering resiliency analysis for diversity RTT floors and available directly for architecture reviews: compare the computed floor with Equinix's measured inter-metro avgLatency to see what the network delivers versus what physics allows.
